Prepares the erun-dind sidecar and then replaces itself with the stock
dockerd-entrypoint.sh, passing DOCKERD_ARGS through.

It reads the MTU of the interface carrying the pod's default route and leads the
daemon's args with --mtu, so builds behind an encapsulating CNI do not stall on
full-size packets. It mirrors the sidecar's own cpu.max into the per-pod cgroup
docker/erun-build-cpu-cap-<pod> that in-pod builds nest under with --cgroup-parent.
Neither step is fatal: when one cannot apply it says so and dockerd starts on its
defaults. Runs only on Linux, inside the sidecar; --dry-run reports both steps and
the dockerd command without writing a cgroup or starting the daemon.

Usage:
  erun dind-entrypoint [-- DOCKERD_ARGS...] [flags]

Examples:
  erun dind-entrypoint -- --insecure-registry registry.cluster.local:5000
  erun dind-entrypoint --dry-run

Flags:
      --dry-run   Resolve and trace mutating actions without executing them.
  -h, --help      help for dind-entrypoint

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.
